narr: The late afternoon sea breeze and boundary mergers focused across the St. Johns River basin across downtown Jacksonville. Slow moving storms within a saturated airmass (precipitable water 2.18) produced locally heavy, flooding rainfall.
ev: Flash flooding from heavy rainfall of 2 inches in 1 hour and up to 3 inches in 1.5 hrs occurred across the downtown and immediate metro area of Jacksonville between 5 pm and 7 pm EDT.
